outcome: mode of birth (normal delivery, cesarean section, instrumental delivery)
cohort: Pregnant women whose pregnancies finished between June 2019 and May 2022 were included, categorized into pre-pandemic and pandemic groups based on pregnancy completion dates.
finding: The incidence of gestational diabetes, hypertension, and preeclampsia increased during the pandemic, while the onset of spontaneous labor was similar between pre-pandemic and pandemic groups.
mod_finding: The pandemic group experienced higher rates of normal and cesarean section deliveries and lower rates of instrumental deliveries.
